# Copilot instructions for this repository

This project must follow the SE-EDU standards for Java and Git.

## Mandatory Java standard

Follow `.github/skills/seedu-java-coding-standard/SKILL.md` for all Java code and all code changes in this project.

## Mandatory Git standard

Follow `.github/skills/seedu-git-standard/SKILL.md` for all future commits, commit messages, and Git-related operations.

## Project-specific repository rules

- Use Java 25 for build and test tasks.
- Prefer lightweight tags unless the user explicitly asks for annotated tags.
- Keep commit messages clear and rationale-driven.
